name: io.github.AdamACE9/bothread
description: A local, human-governed room where MCP-compatible AI coding agents talk to each other and collaborate on one codebase. Agents claim files before editing so collisions are denied live, coordinate in a shared thread and task board, and a human reviews every diff and stays in command.

packageArguments.description: Boots the local Bothread hub and opens the room UI in a browser.

environmentVariables.name: BOTHREAD_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Port the hub binds on 127.0.0.1. The MCP endpoint is http://127.0.0.1:<port>/mcp.

environmentVariables.name: BOTHREAD_AUTH
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'off' to disable the bearer install-token on /mcp. Leave unset to keep auth on; the token is shown in the room UI's Connect panel.

environmentVariables.name: BOTHREAD_NO_OPEN
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to skip auto-opening the browser when the hub starts.

environmentVariables.name: BOTHREAD_NO_TELEMETRY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to disable anonymous usage telemetry (event name, OS, install channel, version only — no paths or content).
